title: Poblanos with Mole Sauce
description: A classic Mexican dish featuring roasted poblano peppers smothered in a rich mole sauce. This recipe is a staple of Mexican cuisine, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 2. Roast the poblano peppers on a baking sheet for 20-25 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
3. Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool in a bowl covered with plastic wrap.
4. Once cool enough to handle, peel the skin off the peppers and slice them into strips.
5. In a large skillet, heat the mole over medium heat.
6. Add the sliced poblanos to the skillet and toss to coat with the mole sauce.
7. Add the zesty spice blend and sugar to the skillet and toss to combine.
9. Serve the poblanos hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
